deploymentEvidence.binding: Verified custom BaseUpgradeabilityProxy stores factory in EIP1967 implementation slot and resolves HasLogic(factory).getLogic(proxyType); proxyType 2 denotes PoolLogic. Sourcify reports factory 0x5e61a079A178f0E5784107a4963baAe0c5a680c6 as implementation, NOT final pool logic. Official Optimism v2.12.0 deployment manifest binds that factory to PoolLogic 0x50e8e2DB93b04827D7fDFeFb5037CC9485eDE388. No current getLogic eth_call or fresh runtime identity proof claimed.

warnings: dHEDGE is now Chamber, the same protocol/vault infrastructure, not a separate new protocol. This capability is only the Ethereum Savings Account managed vault on Optimism (chain 10), not every factory-created pool.

Upgradeable custom proxy resolves factory.getLogic(2); official deployment manifest and verified source bind the recorded PoolLogic implementation. This is source/deployment inventory evidence, not a fresh RPC/runtime implementation attestation or successful execution guarantee.

Deposit requires prior token allowance, a currently enabled deposit asset, valid price, minimum deposit/supply rules and unpaused factory/pool. A manager may make the pool private; then membership authorization is required. Catalog admission does not bypass restrictions.

Withdrawals consume caller-owned shares and distribute proportional supported portfolio assets, not necessarily the original deposit token. Fees, exit cooldown/early-exit allocation, same-block restrictions, valuation checks, and available downstream liquidity apply.

Only deposit is admitted. withdrawSafe/withdrawToSafe remain excluded because the exact supported-assets and registered guard implementation bindings were not established; their bytes interpretation may hide router/target/calldata choices. No claim of a closed execution boundary is made. Unsafe legacy withdrawals are also excluded.

Official app displays about $59.6K managed for this vault at review; this UI figure is not protocol TVL, an audited valuation or DAU/MAU. No users/activity count, liquidity guarantee or financial-safety claim is made.
